page.notes: The last line is cut off at the edge of this part; the word after "vel" and its hyphen are partly visible and read as "ꝯmu[?]-" with uncertainty. The paragraph continues on the next part. The small marks at the left and right edges of the scan are not printed text. The first word of the page is a fragment of Greek, shown only as "πκόν." at the top; the letters before it are not visible, so the reading is doubtful. "Ποιητικὸν" is printed in a bold italic Greek, and the accents may not match exactly. The catchword "cipium" completes the hyphenated word "principium". The text uses plain s for long s throughout, and "sani omnes" appears as "fani omnes" in the scan; the transcription follows the sense, so "sani" should be checked. Reading "quum de iis, quæ sensu percipiuntur, omnes" follows the scan; the word "sani" has been treated as a doubtful reading.
